ios.desc:
Every flight tells a story. Fly is your personal flight journal. A beautifully designed logbook to preserve the journeys that have taken you across the world. Rebuilt from the ground up with Liquid Glass, Fly combines an intuitive map-based interface with powerful logging tools so you can relive every departure, every landing, and every moment in between.

- Your Flights, Beautifully Mapped
Watch your travel history come alive on an interactive world map. Every route you've flown is drawn as a line connecting the places that have shaped your story. Tap any flight to see its full details in an elegant bottom sheet - departure and arrival times, airline, aircraft, seat, and more.

- Effortless Flight Logging
Add flights in seconds. Scan your boarding pass to auto-populate flight details, or simply enter the date and flight number to pull in route, aircraft, and timing data automatically. No internet? No problem. Full offline support means you can add, edit, and browse your flights from anywhere, even at 35,000 feet.

- Works Beautifully Offline
Fly is designed to be used in the air. Add flights, browse your history, edit details, and even attach photos all without an internet connection. Everything syncs seamlessly once you're back online.

- Memories - Attach Photos to Flights (Premium)
That sunrise over the Alps. Your first business class seat. The tray of food you'll never forget. Attach images to any flight and turn your logbook into a visual travel diary you'll treasure for years. Snap a photo mid-flight and add it right there. No connectivity needed. Your memories sync automatically once you land and reconnect.

- Custom Fields - Track What Matters to You (Premium)
Everyone flies differently. Create your own custom fields to track seat numbers, ticket prices, booking references, gate numbers, trip names, traveling companions, lounge visits, Wi-Fi availability, departure delays, or anything else you care about. Choose from text, number, currency, yes/no, and single or multi-select field types.

- Deep Search & Insights
Find any flight instantly. Search across flight numbers, routes, airlines, aircraft types, and more. The Insights tab transforms your travel history into rich charts and statistics. See your most-visited airports, top airlines, busiest travel months, and flight patterns over time.

quotes.text:
So I've just launched this side project that I've been working on. It's a flight logger app much like OpenFlights or MyFlightRadar24. Although, it has some interesting features I found lacking in existing solutions:

- Full offline support.
- Upload pictures for each flight
- Deep search. Search by Airline, Airport, Flight Number, Registration Number, Aircraft etc (All offline btw).
- Quick add by scanning your boarding pass or entering flight number.
- Share your flights by generating a public web URL.
- Import existing flights from OpenFlights or MyFlightRadar24.
- See a bunch of graphs consolidating all your travels.

Here's the landing page: https://flytheapp.com

Direct AppStore link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fly-log-and-share-flights/id1458855818?mt=8

It's completely free to use and you don't even need an email id to use the app.

It's available for iOS as of now. Do let me know if you want to see it on Android and if there's anything else that I can do to improve your experience with Fly.

Happy flying!
quotes.title: Just launched: Fly – A simple app to log and share your flights
